title: GlydeSettingsV1
description: Per-realtor Glyde workflow configuration stored at Realtors/{uid}/GlydeSettings/config.

ownerUid.description: Firebase UID of the realtor who owns this settings document.

enabledWorkflows.description: List of workflow_ids that are enabled for this realtor.

autoReplyEnabled.description: When true AND execution_policy allows volatile_external, auto-reply will send live messages. Default false.

autoReplyTone.description: Tone instruction for auto-reply LLM (e.g. 'professional and warm').

dripCooldownDays.description: Minimum days between drip touches for a single lead. Default 30.

hotLeadThreshold.description: Minimum glydeScore (0-100) to classify a lead as hot. Default 70.

hotLeadMaxCount.description: Maximum number of leads in the hot shortlist. Default 10.

googleAdsAccountId.description: Google Ads customer ID (e.g. '123-456-7890') for this realtor.

metaAdsAccountId.description: Meta Ads account ID (e.g. 'act_123456789') for this realtor.

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of last settings update.
